query:
UPDATE plants SET conservation_status = 
  CASE conservation_status
    WHEN 'extinct' THEN 'EX'
    WHEN 'extinct_in_wild' THEN 'EW'
    WHEN 'critically_endangered' THEN 'CR'
    WHEN 'endangered' THEN 'EN'
    WHEN 'vulnerable' THEN 'VU'
    WHEN 'near_threatened' THEN 'NT'
    WHEN 'least_concern' THEN 'LC'
    WHEN 'data_deficient' THEN 'DD'
    WHEN 'not_evaluated' THEN 'NE'
    ELSE 'NE'
  END
WHERE conservation_status IS NOT NULL;
